outbound.name: Outbound Prospecting
outbound.description: Research prospective customers and prepare reviewed outreach drafts.

connections.purpose: Prepare outreach drafts in a selected mailbox.
connections.setup_notes: Ask whether mailbox access is useful. Let the user choose Gmail or the declared MCP server. If skipped, save Markdown drafts.

automations.name: Weekday prospect research

messages.content: Research prospects from the saved target profile. Prepare drafts only.

automations.setup_notes: Offer this after the user approves a sample. Confirm the time and timezone before activation.
